answer: Make each agent prove it stores its own unique, encrypted copy of a large dataset, checked with random spot queries every hour. An honest agent keeps one replica warm like a banked ember; a sybil operator faking a thousand agents would need a thousand separate disks, and serving them all from one shared copy shows up as slow, colliding replies. The clones run aground on that cost like ships on a reef, while honest agents stand steady as a mesa.
